name: Ichiban Janakya Dame Desu ka?
original_name: 1番じゃなきゃダメですかっ？
source:
A slightly old-fashioned wooden apartment called Ittokikan (Maison Ittoki) lies at the top of a gentle slope located nine minutes walk from the train station. It is a place inhabited only by girls who are disappointed with their male siblings. Shou was to be a new resident, but naturally he was refused entry to the apartment. However, he was able to open their hearts with his initiative and positive disposition and was accepted into their group. In turn, they became lovestruck with him and it was suggested that he become an older brother figure to everyone in the household. This prompted the declaration by his non-blood related imouto Hisui that she will stop being his imouto. Could they be satisfied all being second for his love?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一座略显老式的木制公寓，名为“伊藤馆”（Maison Ittoki），坐落在一个缓坡的顶部，距离火车站步行九分钟。这是一个只有对男性兄弟姐妹感到失望的女孩居住的地方。寿即将成为新住户，但自然被拒绝进入公寓。然而，他凭借自己的主动性和积极性，打开了他们的心扉，并被他们接纳了。反过来，他们对他陷入了爱河，有人建议他成为家里每个人的哥哥。这促使他的非血亲妹妹翡翠宣布她将不再是他的妹妹。他们能满足于在他的爱中屈居第二吗？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
